parties: Vishnu R Dusad (acquirer) / Nucleus Software Exports Limited (target)
headline: Vishnu R Dusad files Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Nucleus Software
sum: Substantial shareholder Vishnu R Dusad has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a material acquisition step or trigger event under the SEBI Takeover Code. The disclosure brackets the event as a regulated acquisition requiring formal transparency under the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses thresholds or enters into a binding agreement to acquire shares; this filing confirms a gate-triggering event and initiates the standstill/public offer mechanics under the Code—expect an open offer or exemption application to follow within prescribed timelines.
detail: Vishnu R Dusad, an identified acquirer, has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a person acquires or agrees to acquire shares that trigger the 25% threshold or when a band crosses the 5% mark. The filing is a public, exchange-regulated transparency step that indicates either a binding agreement or a crossing of acquisition thresholds, and typically precedes an open offer or an exemption order. This is the primary regulatory notification event in any Indian takeover; the acquirer must now comply with standstill, public offer, or exemption mechanisms within 30–60 days.
